features.notes: Pinned compiler uses inclusive maxima internally. For ordinary Uint<0..m> and Uint<0..n>, addition returns exclusive bound m+n-1 and multiplication returns (m-1)*(n-1)+1. Subtraction retains the left maximum and asserts a nonnegative result. Focused Compact 0.36.1 and Noctium source comparisons cover arithmetic, inferred bounds, typed and literal zero, the 248-bit limit, and subtraction underflow. The transparent Compact alias is compared with the underlying Noctium type. Nominal aliases, broader source contexts and complete native proof coverage remain open.
